follow_up.reference: No spanning tree exists. Report impossibility rather than calling a partial forest a full connection.

follow_up.reference: Include its cost and contract its endpoints first. Then connect the remaining components with cheapest safe edges.

follow_up.question: How does Prim differ from Kruskal?
follow_up.reference: Prim grows one connected tree using outgoing edges. Kruskal merges components throughout the network in global cost order.
